title: Application support engineer (Linux, SQL, Oracle)
full_description:
ING Hubs Poland is hiring!
The expected salary for:
Senior Engineer: 9 600 - 21 000 PLN gross
Expert: 13 000 - 24 000 PLN gross
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
We are looking for you, if you:
monitor and maintain application performance, ensuring high availability and reliability,
manage an application on OS level,
perform performance debugging and tuning in Oracle databases,
write and optimize PL/SQL and SQL queries,
you are able to analyze & solve problems efficiently,
you are good at communication and are able to deliver results as promised,
provide 24x7 application support on a rotational basis,
develop and maintain shell scripts for automation and monitoring,
ensure compliance with IT risk management and DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) framework,
You'll get extra points for:
understanding ofaccounting principlesand financial processes.
Your responsibilities:
perform performance debugging and tuning inOracle databases,
write, review, and optimizePL/SQL and SQL queriesfor efficiency and scalability,
conductSQL code optimizationto improve system responsiveness,
develop and maintainshell scriptsfor automation and monitoring tasks,
implement solutions that reduce manual effort and enhance operational efficiency,
provide24x7 application supporton a rotational basis to ensure continuous service availability,
respond to incidents promptly, analyze root causes, and implement preventive measures,
monitor and maintain application performance to ensure optimal availability and reliability,
manage applications at theOS level, including troubleshooting and configuration,
ensure the environment is secure, stable, and compliant with IT risk management standards,
ensure adherence toDORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)and IT risk management frameworks,
maintain documentation and audit readiness for regulatory compliance.
Information about the squad:
Our squad supports application which is a cutting-edge finance management solution designed to centralize and streamline accounting processes across multiple entities and GAAP standards. It supports:
multi-entity and multi-GAAP accountingwith detailed balances in various currencies,
end-to-end automationof accounting workflows, accelerating financial close and ensuring regulatory compliance,
advanced features such asdouble-entry accounting,drill-down reporting, andconfigurable period-end processing.
The role naming convention in the global ING job architecture will be “Engineer III and IV”
